description: Defines data classes related to sharing requests in the Nextcloud Notes Android client, including UpdateShareRequest and attributes classes.

classes.name: UpdateShareRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to update share details, including permissions, password, expiration date, notes, attributes, and email notification option.

classes.name: ShareAttributesV2
classes.description: Data class for share attribute version 2, with scope, key, and value.

classes.name: ShareAttributesV1
classes.description: Data class for share attribute version 1, with scope, key, and enabled status.
